# UI Component Service

## Purpose
The UI Component Service is designed to integrate with the backend permissions system to control frontend visibility and access. It allows the frontend to discover available widgets and components that the currently authenticated user is authorized to see or interact with, based on their roles and permissions.

## Endpoints

| Controller | Endpoint | Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **UIComponent** | `/plugins/UIComponent/getAllUIComponents` | POST | Lists all registered UI components. |
| **UIComponent** | `/plugins/UIComponent/createUIComponent` | POST | Registers a new UI component. |

## Dependencies
- **ui-component-model**: Core component definitions.
- **flexicore-boot**: Plugin infrastructure.

## Interesting Features
- **Component Registry**: Provides a central location for the frontend to discover available widgets and their capabilities.

## Operation Flow
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Controller as UIComponentController
    participant Service as UIComponentService

    User->>Controller: getAllUIComponents(UIComponentFiltering)
    Controller->>Service: getAllUIComponents(UIComponentFiltering)
    Service-->>User: List of Available Components
```
